record.question: Ben's sister doesn't speak French but Ben _________.
record.explanation: Answer C: does. Does is the third-person singular auxiliary that substitutes for “doesn’t speak French” (C). Independent check: The auxiliary “does” is repeated to avoid repeating “speak French”: “Ben does [speak French].” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/auxiliary-verbs. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
